_comment: so one 10-epoch run exercises EVERY new code path: the five feeds, both
dispersion branches, the three labels, the ladder, the trace, the PRIORRES
events, the epoch-status columns, the contingency join and the run-end readout.
Per the staged-cadence directive this runs FIRST; a >= 1 h arm only after it is
WHAT A SMOKE CAN AND CANNOT ESTABLISH (spec section 9's convergence hygiene):
control), gate 2 (LIVE WIRING: non-zero n_rows per armed family, and
the run-end line distinguishing 'ran, saw nothing' from 'never ran'),
gate 7 (cost: ms/epoch against the <= 1 ms budget at 63 stations --
above 5 ms/epoch is an implementation defect, not a bad estimate, and
the report must say so rather than add a stride).
CANNOT -- gates 3-6.  Ten epochs is entirely inside ignition: sigma0 is below
its 200-row warm-up for most families (every t reported RAW FORMAL and
flagged), a free ambiguity absorbs its own arc's misfit exactly, and
the redundancy census measured 43 % of data rows reading uncheckable
cold.  Do NOT quote a ladder occupancy from this run.
